House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for ethnic media for public access television.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; ETHNIC MEDIA. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant program to provide funding to ethnic media organizations creating video content in a language other than English. Grant recipients must make the content available to public, educational, and government access television. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for ethnic media for public access television.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ETHNIC MEDIA.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant program to provide funding to ethnic media organizations creating video content in a language other than English. Grant recipients must make the content available to public, educational, and government access television.
additions: $250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant program to provide funding to ethnic media organizations creating video content in a language other than English. Grant recipients must make the content available to public, educational, and government access television.
